resources.string: With the system volume at 1, pressing down adds reduction instead of muting, and pressing up removes it before raising the system volume.

Use it only if the normal mode does not lower the volume on your phone. It only affects players that announce their audio session (Spotify, YouTube Music, VLC…), and playback must be restarted after enabling it.

The reduction adds to the system volume: set the system volume to its minimum (1) and go lower with the control above or the volume keys. Every 10 dB sounds roughly half as loud. The notification lets you adjust it without opening the app.
